### 0-3. Probability Adjustment — Only by Pre-Committed Rules

**No rule triggered.** R1 is exhausted; R2 (Ship recovery), R3 (2027 equity raise), R4 (ARPU below $60 for two consecutive quarters — currently $69), R5 (Kuiper not launched by end-2027) and R6 (2029 renewal) all have conditions not yet reached. No adjustments outside the rules → **Bull 25% / Base 50% / Bear 25% maintained** (source: `state.probability_adjustment_rules` · [8-K Ex.99.1 KPI table](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066482/spaceexplorationtechnologi.htm)).

**Proposed new rule ⑤ (not reflected in this edition's numbers)**: "If a **termination notice from one of the top two AI customers (reportedly Anthropic and Google) is confirmed in a company filing (8-K·10-Q·10-K)**, Bear +10%p · Bull −5%p." Reason: both contracts are **terminable on 90 days' notice from 1H 2027** (Google after 2026-12-31, Anthropic from early 2027 — both reported), and the existing R6 only looks at the 2029 renewal. The rules do not cover the 2027~2028 gap (source: [Yahoo/Bloomberg 10/29](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/anthropic-accounts-over-third-spacex-014451805.html) · [TechCrunch 2026-06-05](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/05/google-will-pay-spacex-920m-per-month-for-compute/)). Proposals ①~④ are maintained (status in state).
